latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ClawClub skill for OpenClaw.
- Enables users to create and join private, interest-based communities (clubs) with AI-powered member matching and moderation.
- All data remains local; community management uses agent-to-agent communication—no central server.
- Use cases include founder circles, study groups, mastermind groups, local interest groups, and project teams.
- Core features (club creation, member matching) currently in development; not yet fully available.
